questions.subject: Engineering Mathematics
questions.stem: Of the infinite series (i) Σ(n=1..∞) 1/√n, (ii) Σ(n=1..∞) 1/[n(n+1)], and (iii) Σ(n=1..∞) 1/n!, which converge?
questions.explanation: (i) is a divergent p-series with p=1/2. (ii) telescopes, (iii) converges by the ratio test.

questions.stem: Which statements are true for an ideal operational amplifier?
options: It has infinite open-loop differential gain
It has infinite open-loop common-mode gain
questions.explanation: Ideal input resistance and differential gain are infinite. Ideal output resistance is zero; common-mode gain is zero.

questions.stem: For a discrete-time LTI system, the output to δ[n] is 1 at n=0,1,2 and zero otherwise. What is the output for any input x[n]?

questions.stem: For a distribution feeder with resistance-to-reactance ratio R/X=5 and a 350 kVA load at the receiving end, find the lagging power factor for maximum voltage drop to three decimals.

questions.subject: Signals & Systems
questions.stem: Let x₁(t)=1 on [0,1], x₁(t)=2−t on [1,2], zero otherwise. Let x₂(t)=t on [0,1], x₂(t)=2−t on [1,2], zero otherwise. For y(t)=x₁(t)*x₂(t), find ∫(−∞..∞) y(t)dt.

questions.subject: Signals & Systems
questions.stem: A continuous-time LTI system has the unit step u(t) as the output when its input is δ(t). Which statement is necessarily true?
options: Every bounded input gives bounded output
There exists a bounded input that produces an unbounded output
Every input produces a bounded output
Every input produces an unbounded output
questions.explanation: The impulse response h(t)=u(t) is not absolutely integrable, so the system is not BIBO stable; a bounded constant input produces a ramp.

questions.subject: Digital Electronics
questions.topic: Analog-to-digital converters · quantization SNR and bit rate
questions.stem: A 10-bit ADC samples at 1 MHz, has a full-scale voltage of 3.3 V, and receives a 500 kHz sinusoidal input. Find the maximum signal-to-noise ratio (dB, two decimal places) and ADC output data rate (Mbps), respectively.
questions.explanation: Ideal quantization SNR is 6.02N+1.76≈61.96 dB for N=10. Data rate=10 bits/sample × 10⁶ samples/s=10 Mbps.

questions.subject: Engineering Mathematics
questions.stem: Which of these 3×3 matrices is invertible?
questions.explanation: A and D each have proportional rows; B has its second row twice its first. Only C has nonzero determinant.

questions.subject: Signals & Systems
questions.stem: Let y(t)=x(−t), the time reversal of x(t), for all real t. Which property necessarily holds for x(t)*y(t)?
questions.explanation: Convolution of x(t) with x(−t) is its autocorrelation-like function, which is even (for real x).

questions.subject: Electrical Machines
questions.stem: A three-phase 50 Hz, six-pole induction motor runs at 960 rpm. Neglect stator copper, core and rotational losses. Find the percentage efficiency.
questions.explanation: Synchronous speed is 1000 rpm; slip=0.04, so mechanical power/air-gap power=1−s=0.96.

questions.subject: Power Systems
questions.topic: Instrument transformers · CT and PT features
questions.stem: Match instrument transformers X=Current Transformer (CT), Y=Potential Transformer (PT) to properties P=primary connected in parallel to grid, Q=open-circuit secondary undesirable, R=primary current equals line current, S=secondary burden affects primary current. Which mapping is correct?
questions.explanation: CT primary is series with line; CT secondary open circuit is unsafe. PT primary connects in parallel. Official mapping X:Q,R; Y:P,S.
